description: Exact official Fish Audio Drama 3 checkpoint (35B-total / 3B-active Qwen3.5 MoE backbone with block-FP8 routed experts and BF16 elsewhere, a 10-codebook audio tower and the bundled 44.1 kHz DAC codec): expressive speech in 83 languages, up to 16 speakers per request through speaker tags, inline event tags such as [sighs] or [laughs] (the checkpoint also clones a voice from a reference clip and its transcript).
